editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Interactive Brokers is not a forex broker that also offers stocks. It is a $120.8 billion NASDAQ-listed global brokerage that also happens to offer forex — alongside stocks, options, futures, bonds, funds, crypto, and prediction markets across 150+ exchanges in 34 countries. NAFT scores Interactive Brokers 9.0 out of 10 in 2026. Ten Tier-1 regulatory licences including SEC/FINRA/CFTC, FCA, ASIC, MAS, SFC, CIRO, JFSA, and FINMA make this the most broadly regulated broker we have ever reviewed. SIPC protection up to $500,000 for US clients and FSCS up to GBP 85,000 for UK clients provide the strongest investor protection available anywhere. The 57.4% retail CFD loss rate is the lowest we have ever recorded — a full 10 percentage points below IG and 20+ points below most competitors, suggesting a materially more experienced client base. The honest trade-off: this platform was designed by engineers for professionals. TWS is powerful but unforgiving. The learning curve is steep, the interface is dense, and there is no hand-holding. If you already know what you are doing, nothing in the retail space comes close to IBKR's combination of cost, access, and safety. If you are still learning, open elsewhere first and come back when you are ready.
